name: Close Out
idea: Run to the shooter fast, then take short steps and get a hand up high.
why: If you run all the way in, the shooter just dribbles past you. Short steps at the end let you stop in time and still block their view of the basket.
tryit: Close-out drill: start under the basket, sprint to a cone, then finish with five short, choppy steps and one hand high.

frames.say: You’re on defense. {X2} is helping in the middle, far away from {2}.
*Close out!* {1} passes to {2}, so {X2} sprints toward {2}.
Near {2}, {X2} takes short, choppy steps and puts a hand up high. Don’t fly past!
{2} can’t get a good shot, so {2} passes the ball back out. Great close out!
